quests.title: The Sisterhood of Elune
quests.description:
Blessings to you, hunter. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.

quests.title: Rellian Greenspyre
quests.objectiveText: Bring a Timberling Seed to Rellian Greenspyre in Darnassus.
quests.description:
Evalhunter, can you take one of the seeds you brought me to my friend, Rellian Greenspyre?  He is a druid in Darnassus, and when last we spoke he revealed his interest in my work with the Timberlings.  He had some ideas himself, and he will appreciate a specimen seed to work with.

Thank you, Evalhunter.  You have been a great help to me.  I hope that, some day, you will see the fruit of my labors.

You will usually find Rellian walking the pathways of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.
quests.objectives: Bring a Timberling Seed to Rellian Greenspyre in Darnassus. [DONE]

quests.title: The Lost Runner
quests.description:
The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.

I received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.

Please head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.
quests.objectiveText: Search for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road leading to the Oracle Glade.

quests.description:
All was not well with Teldrassil, however. Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on Teldrassil may be attributed.

However, I will not get into that yet. You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.
whereToGet: Filled Amethyst Phial: from object Oracle Glade Moonwell — Teldrassil 38.4, 34.1 (1602 m, 1 spawn point in your zone)
quests.title: Crown of the Earth
quests.objectiveText: Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.

quests.description:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.

Mature Fel Moss: dropped by Xethorr the Wicked (level 12) — Teldrassil 60.1, 42.4 (832 m, 11 spawn points in your zone)
quests.title: Twisted Hatred
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Befouled Webwoods and bring Xethorr the Wicked's Mature Fel Moss to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.

quests.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, hunter. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
whereToGet: Nadyia Maneweaver: kill Nadyia Maneweaver (level 30) — Teldrassil 41.9, 49.4 (1191 m, 1 spawn point in your zone)
quests.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Nadyia Maneweaver on the road to Darnassus from Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
quests.objectives: Raise your leatherworking skill to 20 [TO DO]

whereToGet: Radnaal Maneweaver: kill Radnaal Maneweaver (level 19) — Teldrassil 42.1, 50.0 (1175 m, 1 spawn point in your zone)
quests.title: Camping 101: Skinning
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Radnaal Maneweaver on the road to Darnassus from Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
quests.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
quests.objectives: Raise your skinning skill to 20 [TO DO]

whereToGet: Strigid Screecher: kill Strigid Screecher (level 7-8) — Teldrassil 64.2, 69.2 (24 m, 36 spawn points in your zone)
quests.title: Taming the Beast
quests.objectiveText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Strigid Screecher. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
quests.description:
You have tamed two creatures that inhabit the land, now you must tame one that soars the skies. Use the taming rod to tame a strigid screecher, found west of here. Practice your skills with this mighty owl at your side.

When you return, I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing to be your companion; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.
